title: M-12 carrying D-21 drone in flight (CIA OXCART history, p. 293)
description: Boxed photograph of a dark M-12 aircraft in flight with a D-21 drone mounted on its upper rear fuselage, seen from below against a pale sky. The caption reads "M-12 carrying D-21 Drone." Text discusses 1963 concerns about Lockheed's supersonic-technology headstart and deliberations with Presidents Kennedy and Johnson about surfacing the OXCART program.
